If motor sequence learning drives experience-dependent microstructural reorganization during consolidation, then task-engaged hippocampal and cortical regions will show increased soma and neurite fractions and decreased mean diffusivity from baseline to 24 hours post-learning that positively correlate with micro-offline and overnight offline behavioral gains.
